purpose: Manage saved geofence boundaries and charging-place purpose, review independent visited-place evidence, optionally draft with Helix, and manage place-specific pricing and charging history.
primaryGoal: Review a location and explicitly create or maintain its saved boundary without confusing an observed visited candidate, an AI proposal, and a persisted geofence.

dataSources.name: Saved geofence summary and CRUD
dataSources.behavior: Read receives cancellation signal. Success invalidates the geofences key prefix, reports localized toast and closes the relevant modal/dialog. Summary is fleet-wide, not selected-vehicle filtered. Legacy camelCase needsReview is used for summary counts.

dataSources.name: Visited candidates and saved-name resolution
dataSources.behavior: Independent candidate cache, safeArray selection and 30-second staleTime. Candidate IDs feed review and optional drafting; selecting or drafting does not persist a place. Saved names are preferred before reverse geocoding.

dataSources.name: Directory, discovery queue and current rates
dataSources.behavior: Full canonical snake_case cache is separate from summary cache. Active/archived keys remain separate. Directory sources poll every 30 seconds with 15-second staleTime. Search, pin ordering and selection are local presentation; bulk deletion explicitly confirms and uses a live-mode mutation.

dataSources.name: Place detail lifecycle and pricing
dataSources.behavior: Queries are ID-enabled and cancellation-aware; writes opt into requiresLiveMode and invalidate/broadcast relevant sources. Currency/Wh stays on wire, currency/kWh is presentation/request boundary conversion. Preview and explicit apply are distinct. Backend cost-protection claims in UI comments were not independently verified.

dataSources.name: Vehicle or browser coordinates
dataSources.behavior: Only location acquisition uses selected vehicle; no live-current guarantee is inferred from positions?limit=1. Browser acquisition requests high accuracy with 10-second timeout and handles unsupported/denied/error cases. User-entered name survives capture.

dataSources.name: AI review-only draft
dataSources.routeEvidence: internal\api\router.go:5053 delegates mountAIRoutes; exact delegated leaf not inspected
dataSources.behavior: Feature-gated input and card; positive visited location_id required. Stream captures a typed envelope, rejects non-ok application, cancels and clears on scope/unmount. Apply to form only copies proposal fields; Create remains the persistence action.

dataSources.name: Pins and map configuration
dataSources.routeEvidence: Map config: web\src\api\settings.ts:133 and internal\api\router.go:4386. Pinned leaf routing not established in inspected router excerpts.
dataSources.behavior: Pins use user/context-aware keys and broadcast invalidation. Map provider and low-bandwidth tile policy belong to existing shared map owner. No tile-provider request or authentication was exercised.

issues.rule: MDC-046 preservation of unsaved user input
issues.detail: Dirty tracking includes chargingPlace only when reviewCandidate is non-null. Toggling charging purpose in an otherwise untouched ordinary Create form is not dirty, so Cancel can discard that change without the existing discard prompt.
issues.fix: Snapshot charging purpose for every create/draft mode and include it in the dirty comparison; retain existing confirmation preference and navigation behavior.

issues.detail: applyAiDraftToForm initializes name/geometry/category but not chargingPlace or reviewCandidate; closeModal clears reviewCandidate but leaves chargingPlace. After a reviewed charging candidate closes, applying an AI draft can inherit the previous charging purpose and later POST it at line 507.
issues.fix: Make draft initialization explicit and independent of prior candidate/create state; preserve existing review-before-Create path and do not auto-persist.

issues.detail: AI candidate picker uses data??[] but has no local loading/unavailable/error/retry cue. Candidate failures are separately exposed by the visited card/source composition, not this selector. Summary onRetry is supported by MapsOperationalBrief but not passed here.
issues.fix: Reuse existing data-state/source UI and clearly connect candidate retry to the picker without replacing useful neighboring data or adding a new state engine.

visualIssues.detail: The drawing surface has fixed border-white/[0.08] instead of theme-aware border token. This is the only fixed-white styling match in the page, not evidence of a page full of white text.
visualIssues.fix: Use existing semantic surface/border token; validate light/dark/custom and forced colors.

visualIssues.detail: Shared drawer defaults to saturated literal cyan #22d3ee with fillOpacity 0.15 at line 93; page supplies no color. No glow was found in the inspected page. Shape visibility is important, so contrast cannot be traded away merely to lower saturation.
visualIssues.fix: Have shared map owner review a restrained semantic geometry default/variant using the existing color prop; preserve shape meaning and measure against actual tiles.

visualIssues.detail: Page explicitly requests dark map style. Shared MapTileLayer respects provider/data-saver but this source choice is independent of application light theme. Actual contrast or mismatch is not visually proven.

visualIssues.detail: AI proposal uses local text-xs/text-sm tracking/font-medium rather than role typography; cyan border/fill/label is subdued but cumulative intensity with directory badges requires visual review.
visualIssues.fix: AI owner should reuse existing typography roles and restrained semantic surfaces without dropping proposal fields or validation explanation.

architectureIssues.detail: Local CRUD requests omit requiresLiveMode and invalidate locally, whereas useLocations lifecycle/bulk writes opt into live mode and cross-tab broadcast. request() defaults requiresLiveMode=false at client.ts:373 and calls the operational guard at 378; guard implementation was not inspected, so no demo/auth bypass is alleged.
architectureIssues.fix: Unify through existing typed domain mutation contracts while preserving success/error/modal behavior and query identity; verify actual demo/offline behavior centrally.

architectureIssues.detail: Summary consumes legacy Geofence (string ID, needsReview) while workspace uses canonical ApiGeofence (numeric ID, needs_review, charging purpose). Both types were inspected; runtime dual-casing behavior was not. Do not merge shapes or caches casually.
architectureIssues.fix: Coordinate canonical typed hooks/summary adapter with useLocations owner and preserve origin/review semantics; avoid coercion-based compatibility inventions.

architectureIssues.detail: useToast imports directly from @/components/feedback/Toast rather than the feedback category barrel.
architectureIssues.fix: Use the existing feedback barrel if the hook is exported; report a barrel gap instead of changing shared exports from a page worker.

architectureIssues.detail: Vehicle selection is header-enabled by workspaceScope.ts:22-74,97-136,156-165; modal also renders a vehicle selector at page line 654 which changes the same setVehicleId. It serves location capture, not directory filtering, and selected-vehicle changes have global consequences.
architectureIssues.fix: Coordinate capture-source selection with workspace owner; do not simply remove the needed location-source capability or add a second independent workspace store.

architectureIssues.detail: Drawer receives onCreate only. GeofenceDrawer.tsx:115-117 disables edit/delete tools when callbacks are absent; page comment at line 277 about editing does not prove editable map geometry.
architectureIssues.fix: Preserve existing circle creation and numeric editing; treat additional on-map edit/delete as a separate explicitly authorized capability, not an already working behavior.

dataBehavior: Visited candidate is observed evidence, not a saved geofence. openCandidate prefills name/coordinates, radius 75 and charging purpose from charge_count; Create is still required.
Ordinary create begins empty with radius 100/custom and false charging purpose. AI proposal remains a draft, prefills geometry/name/custom and must be reviewed then explicitly created.
Current AI inherited charging-purpose risk and ordinary-create dirty tracking gap are flagged, not silently blessed or changed by this audit.
Editing preserves ID and category; update sends validated form payload, not server-managed origin/review flags. Charging purpose for saved places is maintained by the detail workspace.
Circle radius is meter-labeled and validated 10..50000; latitude -90..90, longitude -180..180, name trimmed 1..120. No new wire field or unit guess.

Map fallback center 37.7749,-122.4194 is only navigation context, not fake measured data; (0,0) is currently excluded from draft/center validity at lines 261,286 and must not be reinterpreted casually.

Selected vehicle affects capture only; directory/candidates are independent fleet-wide sources. /geofences has no workspace analysis range. Rate effective dates and preview bounds are independent business scope.
Raw rate_per_wh and energy_wh stay intact; helpers convert only price entry/display boundary, useUnits formats energy; summaries remain separated by currency.
Keep all cache keys, enablement, cancellation, staleTime/polling, mutation invalidation/broadcast, table IDs, pin context and saved preferences.
Do not invent backend deduplication, live-position freshness, charging discovery accuracy, cost-protection guarantees or successful mutation outcomes from route declarations/comments.
